sentences.en: The project was run by Computacenter's project mangers from start to finish.

sentences.en: Mangers showing fattened cattle and gazelles feeding were discovered there and the emplacements are still there now.

sentences.en: They have been protected for over 50 years and we work with owners and land mangers to keep them in the best condition.

sentences.en: Buy handcrafted manger scenes at Christmas Mangers.

sentences.en: Make certain that all mangers and supervisors are trained to recognize potential workplace hazards.

sentences.en: Meet with area mangers to find out what their hiring needs and policies are.

sentences.en: Community mangers whose duties include sales must hold a valid real estate license in the state where they are employed.

sentences.en: Agency mangers are generally paid a salary with a performance bonus, although this varies widely among different companies.
sentences.vi: Người quản lý đại lý thường được trả lương kèm theo phần thưởng hiệu suất, mặc dù điều này rất khác nhau giữa các công ty khác nhau.
